# AI asset generation

Text/image-to-3D, image generation, audio/SFX/music, NPC voices (TTS), speech-to-text, and ML that runs in the browser. Model weights often carry their own licences; read the notes column.

Stars checked 2026-09-23. Notes: [notes/ai-assets.md](../notes/ai-assets.md). Sync locally: `node scripts/sync.mjs --category ai-assets`

### 3d-generation

| Repo | ★ | License | What it is | What we take from it | Sync |
|---|---:|---|---|---|---|
| [Tencent-Hunyuan/Hunyuan3D-2](https://github.com/Tencent-Hunyuan/Hunyuan3D-2) | 15.0k | ⚠️ custom — read it | Hunyuan3D 2.0: a DiT shape generator and a texture paint model, with mini, turbo and multiview variants. | Fast turbo or mini variants for draft props and texture passes on existing meshes. — _LICENCE CAVEAT: the same Tencent Community License as 2.1. It excludes the EU, UK and South Korea, and has the 1M MAU clause._ | docs |
| [microsoft/TRELLIS](https://github.com/microsoft/TRELLIS) | 13.7k | MIT | Structured 3D latents model (CVPR'25) that generates meshes, 3D Gaussians or radiance fields from text or an image. | The more established TRELLIS v1 for batch-generating set dressing. It has the larger community of ComfyUI wrappers. — _Needs a CUDA GPU and runs offline only._ | docs |
| [microsoft/TRELLIS.2](https://github.com/microsoft/TRELLIS.2) | 11.3k | MIT | Microsoft's newer image-to-3D model built on compact structured latents. It outputs textured meshes with PBR materials. | Turn concept art of hero props (crashed-craft debris, alien artifacts, 1950s lab gear) into GLB files for R3F, then clean them up with gltf-transform. — _The README puts the model and code under MIT. Rendering needs nvdiffrast and nvdiffrec, which have their own NVIDIA licences, so check them before any commercial pipeline._ | docs |
| [VAST-AI-Research/TripoSR](https://github.com/VAST-AI-Research/TripoSR) | 7.0k | MIT | Fast feed-forward mesh reconstruction from a single image (under a second on a GPU). | Cheap, clean-licence baseline for turning photos or sketches of small objects into rough meshes that are then retopologised. — _MIT for code and weights, making it the safest 3D-generation licence in this list._ | docs |
| [Tencent-Hunyuan/Hunyuan3D-2.1](https://github.com/Tencent-Hunyuan/Hunyuan3D-2.1) | 4.1k | ⚠️ custom — read it | Image-to-3D shape generation plus a PBR texture painter that produces production-ready materials. | High-quality shapes with PBR textures for the key evidence objects players inspect up close. — _LICENCE CAVEAT: the Tencent Hunyuan 3D 2.1 Community License does not apply in the EU, UK or South Korea (no licence is granted there). Services above 1M monthly active users must request a licence, and an Acceptable Use Policy applies. Avoid it if the team or players are in the EU/UK._ | docs |
| [Stability-AI/stable-fast-3d](https://github.com/Stability-AI/stable-fast-3d) | 1.8k | ⚠️ custom — read it | SF3D: fast single-image mesh reconstruction with UV unwrapping and delighted albedo, roughness and metal. | Game-ready UV-unwrapped meshes in about a second, a good fit for lots of small clutter props. — _LICENCE CAVEAT: Stability AI Community License. Free for research, non-commercial use and commercial use under $1M annual revenue; above that you need an enterprise licence. Last push was 2025-01._ | docs |
| [VAST-AI-Research/TripoSG](https://github.com/VAST-AI-Research/TripoSG) | 1.8k | MIT | High-fidelity image-to-3D shape synthesis with rectified-flow models (geometry only). | Sharper geometry than TripoSR for hard-surface UFO and military props. Pair it with MV-Adapter or Hunyuan paint for textures. — _Last push was 2025-04._ | docs |
